stories.title: Trump bereidt sancties voor tegen Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag

en.title: Trump prepares sanctions against International Criminal Court in The Hague
en.summary: The Trump administration is preparing to impose sanctions on the entire International Criminal Court, escalating its confrontation with the international tribunal.

stories.title: Regering-Trump bereidt sancties voor tegen hele Strafhof in Den Haag

en.title: Trump administration prepares sanctions against entire Court in The Hague
en.summary: The Trump government is preparing sanctions against the complete International Criminal Court.

stories.title: Grote klap voor Merz: CDU haalt voor het eerst geen kiesdrempel in deelstaat

en.title: Major blow for Merz: CDU fails to clear electoral threshold in state for first time
en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz's CDU failed to meet the electoral threshold in Germany's Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania regional election, while the far-right AfD won again.

stories.title: Nederlandse studenten gaan weer meer de grens over, nog niet zo vaak als voor corona

en.title: Dutch students cross border more often again, though not as frequently as before coronavirus
en.summary: Dutch students are increasingly traveling across borders, though participation levels remain below pre-pandemic figures.

stories.title: 'Regering-Trump heeft plannen klaar voor sancties tegen Internationaal Strafhof'

en.title: Trump administration has sanctions plans ready for International Criminal Court
en.summary: The Trump administration has prepared sanctions against the International Criminal Court and plans to announce them soon, according to government sources. Previously, the White House sanctioned individual ICC judges and prosecutors.

stories.title: Pijnlijk verlies CDU in Duitse deelstaat: voor het eerst kiesdrempel niet gehaald

en.title: Painful loss for CDU in German state: fails to clear electoral threshold for first time
en.summary: The CDU failed to reach the 5 percent electoral threshold in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania state elections, marking its first such failure in state election history. The Alternative for Germany party won with 38.2 percent, more than doubling its support from five years earlier.

stories.title: Regeringspartij van Poetin leidt bij verkiezingen zonder oppositie in Rusland

en.title: Putin's Ruling Party Leads in Russian Elections Without Opposition
en.summary: Putin's governing party is winning Russia's parliamentary elections with 57.5 percent of votes counted so far, dominating elections that lacked credible opposition candidates.

stories.title: Bij Doema-verkiezingen zonder oppositie gaat Kremlinpartij ruim aan kop

en.title: At Duma elections without opposition, Kremlin party leads by wide margin
en.summary: Putin-aligned United Russia is on track to win Russian parliamentary elections decisively with 57.9 percent of votes counted so far. The Communist Party and Liberal Democratic Party trail in second and third place.

stories.title: Deelstaatverkiezingen in Duitsland: opnieuw grote winst voor het extreemrechtse AfD, CDU van Merz keldert

en.title: State elections in Germany: another major gain for far-right AfD, Merz's CDU plummets
en.summary: The Alternative für Deutschland appears to become the largest party in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern following success in Saxony-Anhalt, while left-wing parties in Berlin enable a potential coalition between Die Linke, the Greens, and the SPD.

stories.title: Haenen stopt na vijftig jaar als stem van Bert, na het overlijden van ‘zijn’ Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, ‘uit eerbied en voor de vriendschap’

en.title: Haenen stops after fifty years as voice of Bert, following the death of 'his' Ernie, Wim T. Schippers, 'out of respect and for the friendship'
en.summary: A voice actor for the character Bert has ended a fifty-year career following the death of the actor who played Ernie.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert in Sesamstraat: 'Waar ben je nou Ernie, ik mis je'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as voice of Bert in Sesame Street: 'Where are you now Ernie, I miss you'
en.summary: Actor Paul Haenen is retiring after over fifty years as the voice of Bert in the Dutch version of Sesame Street, citing the death of his longtime colleague Wim T. Schippers who voiced Ernie. Haenen will also stop voicing Grover.

stories.title: Paul Haenen stopt als Bert uit Sesamstraat na dood collega: 'Waar ben je, Ernie?'

en.title: Paul Haenen stops as Bert from Sesame Street after colleague's death: 'Where are you, Ernie?'
en.summary: Paul Haenen is ending his over fifty-year career voicing Bert in Sesame Street following the death of colleague Wim T. Schippers in June, who provided the voice for Ernie.
